::: {.why}
Everything from phases 4, 5 and 6 meets here, and the number that comes out is the one milestone 6 reports, so today is about making sure it is produced by the whole pipeline rather than by a shortcut.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Produce the combined book's result through the full pipeline: signals, combination, risk model, neutralisation, sizing, costs.
- Attribute the combined performance across signals and say which contributes most after accounting for correlation.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Run the full pipeline and check the seams: the combined score feeds the weight map, the weight map feeds neutralisation, neutralisation feeds volatility targeting, and the engine applies costs per fill. Confirm the accounting identity still holds and that turnover is what the netting analysis predicted.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Attribute the result: marginal contribution of each signal to the combined information ratio, computed by removing one signal at a time rather than by looking at standalone performance. A signal with a poor standalone result and low correlation can contribute more than a good correlated one, and this is where that shows up.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
The combined alpha book runs through the whole pipeline end to end and produces one result object, with each signal's marginal contribution computed by leave-one-out rather than by standalone performance.
:::
